Faculty positions No. of seats Honorarium Duration Part-time Faculty in Law 03 Rs.
43,275/- per month fixed Session 2024-25 Minimum Qualification is as per
UGC/P.U.norms.
(https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/5323630_New_Draft_UGCRegulatio
n2018-9-2.pdf) All the applicants are advised to send/submit their applications
to the Chairperson, Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh along with
all self-attested copies of their certificates and other relevant documents including
publications for verification along with the duly filled application form and template
pages 1 to 11 (https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2
018.pdf ) on or before 12th September, 2025 by 4:00 pm. (Late applications will
not be considered). At the time (11:00 a.m) of interview (physical presence is
mandatory) on 15th September, 2025 at office of Chairperson, Department of
Laws, PU Chandigarh, candidates are required to bring all the supporting
documents/certificates/publications in original. Candidates are required to report
at 10:00 a.m on the date of interview. Kindly be in touch with Panjab University
and Dept. of Laws website for further updates. The candidate shall have to give
an undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial
assistance from any agency till they are teaching at Department of Laws, Panjab
University, Chandigarh as a Guest / Part-Time Faculty.
Sd/-
Chairperson
